entity.must-have-key: Strong entity must have at least one key attribute.
entity.weak-missing-discriminant: Weak entity must have a discriminant attribute.
entity.must-have-attribute: Entity must have at least one attribute.
entity.weak-total-participation: Weak entity must have total participation in the identifying relationship.
entity.weak-not-on-1-side: Weak entity cannot be on the 1-side of the identifying relationship (must be N-side).
entity.weak-single-identifying: Weak entity must connect to exactly one identifying relationship (currently {{count}}).
entity.name-unique: Entity name "{{name}}" is already used by another entity.
entity.name-non-empty: Entity name must not be empty.
entity.orphan-warning: Entity has no relationships (may be incomplete).
entity.weak-no-key: Weak entity must not have a key attribute; use a discriminant (partial key) instead.

relationship.min-two-entities: Relationship must connect at least 2 entities (or be a recursive relationship).
relationship.cardinality-required: All connections on this relationship must have cardinality defined.
relationship.participation-required: All connections on this relationship must have participation defined.
relationship.identifying-needs-weak: Identifying relationship must connect at least one weak entity.
relationship.non-identifying-not-weak: Non-identifying relationship should not be marked as identifying.
relationship.name-unique: Relationship name "{{name}}" is already used by another relationship.
relationship.recursive-roles-distinct: Recursive relationship must have distinct, non-empty roles on both edges.

attribute.single-parent: Attribute must connect to exactly one parent (entity, relationship, or composite attribute).
attribute.no-dual-parent: Attribute cannot connect to both an entity and a relationship.
attribute.discriminant-weak-only: Discriminant is only valid on attributes of a weak entity.
attribute.not-key-and-derived: Attribute cannot be both key and derived.
attribute.relationship-not-key: Attributes of a relationship cannot be key attributes.
attribute.name-unique: Attribute name "{{name}}" is already used by another attribute on the same parent.
attribute.composite-needs-sub: Composite attribute should have at least one sub-attribute.
attribute.sub-not-key: Sub-attribute cannot be a key attribute.
attribute.sub-not-composite: Sub-attribute cannot itself be composite (only one level of nesting).

generalization.parent-exists: ISA generalization must have a parent entity.
generalization.has-children: ISA generalization must have at least one child.
generalization.single-child-warning: ISA with a single child is semantically weak — consider whether specialization is meaningful.

structural.dangling-edge: Edge references a node that does not exist.
